canonicalisers.topology: 12 axial D6 transforms plus translation. Terrain, movement cost, anchor/deployment roles, controlled/permanent passage flags and hazard roles retained. Artwork, entity IDs and pressure numbers omitted. Known engine station IDs resolve to semantic roles; renamed records require explicit role metadata.
canonicalisers.puzzle: 8 row and 8 column permutations preserving 2x2 boxes, transpose and all 24 digit bijections (first-occurrence normalisation). Given positions and digit equality, sum-cage cell incidence/linked marker and protection-group membership/effects retained. Decorative IDs/order, sums and solved numeric grids do not count as materially different dependency patterns. Redundant identical constraints are deduplicated. This is a pattern classifier, not a truth/difficulty or tactical certificate.
